samples.xml_description:
Implement a module to achieve serial input data accumulation output, input is 8bit data. Clock input for synchronization. Active-low reset signal. 8-bit input data for addition. Input signal indicating readiness for new data. Output signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is reached. 10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum. State 0 of the FSM. State 1 of the FSM. State 2 of the FSM. State 3 of the FSM. State register of the FSM. Next state register of the FSM. Count register to count the number of input data. Register to store the accumulated sum.

When valid_in is 1, data_in is a valid input. Accumulate four valid input data_in values and calculate the output data_out by adding these four values together.

There is no output when there are fewer than four data_in inputs in the interim. Along with the output data_out, a cycle of valid_out=1 will appear as a signal.

The valid_out signal is set to 1 when the data_out outputs 4 received data accumulation results. Otherwise, it is set to 0.
